Usage: srv <command> [options]

Serve the store.

Commands:
  serve    Run the server.
  migrate  Run the migrations.

Options:
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON or INI.                                             env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
  -v, --verbose      Log more.                                                               env SRV_VERBOSE, key verbose
